description: This file defines a React functional component named Cell, which represents a single cell in a tic-tac-toe game grid. It manages rendering a button with specific styles and accessibility attributes, displaying the cell's value and highlighting winning cells.

methods.name: Cell
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a tic-tac-toe cell as an accessible button, showing its value ('X', 'O', or empty), handling clicks, and highlighting if part of a winning line.
